description: This file defines a custom exception class `GlobalConfigurationPropertyCannotBeModfied` used in the Fineract platform to indicate an attempt to modify a configuration property that is not allowed. It extends `AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException` and provides a specific error message with the configuration ID.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationPropertyCannotBeModfied
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a global configuration property cannot be modified.

methods.name: GlobalConfigurationPropertyCannotBeModfied
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with a message indicating that the configuration with the specified ID cannot be modified.
